text: Shoppers who see a Nordace ad and search Reddit may mostly meet complaints about Nordace backpacks, since the user reports that the Lévant has no reviews yet; if so, tote-specific proof such as warranty terms, owner reports over time and an honest weight might be needed before cold traffic converts.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0043: the no-reviews premise is the user's statement (E-0434); what shoppers would find is a prediction.
